summary: Forwarding thunk (__stdcall) that calls the Winsock WSACleanup() library routine and returns its result. Used as an indirection point so callers reference a stable binary-local address instead of the import directly.

operations.description: Invoke WSACleanup() and propagate its return value.
Return the integer status produced by WSACleanup().

unresolved: Which subsystem calls this thunk to tear down Winsock state.
Why an import is reached through a thunk rather than directly.
